brief:
BRIEF FOR TEAM TS3012 BEFORE MEETING TS3012d
Based on meetings TS3012a, TS3012b, TS3012c.

The team has finalized major design decisions for the television remote control, including adding an LCD screen, voice recognition, a yellow rubber casing, and standard battery power. Remaining open discussions center on body color strategy, product line editions, and internal component layout.

DECIDED SO FAR
- The remote control will include an LCD screen positioned at the top of the device. [TS3012b, Speaker A: "So we have three people saying it should be on top."] [TS3012c, Speaker A: "Oh let's go for let's say because it is uh very hot in n our target group I think, we should take it take it t to consideration"]
- Voice recognition technology will be implemented in the remote control design. [TS3012c, Speaker A: "If it's small, if it's fits, if if people like it, why not?"]
- The casing will be made of yellow rubber to provide durability and match corporate colors. [TS3012c, Speaker A: "Okay, so we're definitely going for rubber."] [TS3012c, Speaker A: "I think we should th then take it take yellow."]
- The remote control will be powered by standard batteries housed in the bottom section. [TS3012c, Speaker A: "energy, we choose regular regular batteries."] [TS3012c, Speaker A: "Okay, so we put the batteries here."]
- A beep function will be included to assist users in locating the lost remote control. [TS3012b, Speaker A: "I think the p yeah, the beep is a very simple thing to imple implement,"]
- The team decided against a scroll wheel, choosing push-buttons with triangular main navigation controls. [TS3012c, Speaker B: "the triangles would be best indeed."] [TS3012c, Speaker A: "No r no scroll-wheel. Okay. Um I don't see anything missing really."]

WHAT CHANGED ALONG THE WAY
- The LCD screen was initially dropped due to cost and battery concerns, but was later included because target consumers under forty requested it. [TS3012b, Speaker A: "I think we should lose the L_C_D_ screen, like you said."] [TS3012c, Speaker A: "Oh let's go for let's say because it is uh very hot in n our target group I think, we should take it take it t to consideration"]
- Speech recognition was initially rejected due to regional localization complexity, but was later adopted when a compact component became available and high user demand was confirmed. [TS3012b, Speaker A: "Speech recognition, I think it's very hard, because we're selling across multiple countries."] [TS3012c, Speaker A: "If it's small, if it's fits, if if people like it, why not?"]
- A general light material was originally proposed for the remote casing, but rubber was chosen to prevent damage from drops. [TS3012a, Speaker C: "material it is made of, it should be something light."] [TS3012c, Speaker A: "Okay, so we're definitely going for rubber."]
- Kinetic energy was proposed as the power source, but regular batteries were selected because remote controls sit stationary ninety-nine percent of the time. [TS3012c, Speaker C: "My personal uh fav favourite is the kinetic provision"] [TS3012c, Speaker A: "Okay, will just take regular batteries."]
- A standard scroll-wheel was proposed as an inexpensive control, but was removed after the team agreed it lacked useful functionality. [TS3012c, Speaker C: "I think would be cool, scroll-wheel. It's not that much uh if we take a normal scroll-wheel without the pushing, then it's not expensive."] [TS3012c, Speaker A: "No r no scroll-wheel. Okay. Um I don't see anything missing really."]

OPEN ACTIONS AND OWNERS
- Speaker A will draft and work on the project's year-end report. Owner: A (project manager). [TS3012c, Speaker A: "I'm supposed to do the little work on the year-end report."]
- Speaker A is responsible for placing presentation materials and meeting minutes into the shared project folder. Owner: A (project manager). [TS3012a, Speaker A: "I'll put the the minutes of every meeting, I'll put them there too,"]

DISAGREEMENTS STILL OPEN
- B objected to a bright yellow main body colour, preferring a neutral base with changeable covers, while A insisted on a yellow body per corporate requirements. [TS3012c, Speaker B: "it's better to have a neutral base colour than to have a flashy"] [TS3012c, Speaker A: "I think we should go with uh with the company colour because what specific info that I got from the project board."]
- B proposed releasing both a deluxe LCD model and a standard non-LCD model, whereas A recommended focusing exclusively on the deluxe edition. [TS3012c, Speaker B: "I have two designs, one including uh an L_C_D_ screen, wh which is basically the deluxe edition. And then I also have a standard edition,"] [TS3012c, Speaker A: "I think we're going towards the deluxe edition anyway, because that seems to be what the people want."]
- B questioned whether placing batteries in the bottom section would interfere with space needed for the LCD screen. [TS3012c, Speaker B: "Won't that be a problem with the L_C_D_ screen?"]
- B objected to shaping the remote body like a fruit due to changing trends, proposing fruit covers instead while C suggested a Chiquita banana special edition. [TS3012c, Speaker B: "a seasonal, a trend thing. The idea now is is"] [TS3012c, Speaker C: "Maybe once we can make a special edition in according with Chiquita. Have ourselves sponsored."]
